fact_text: Cement is a low value-to-weight product, so freight cost limits sales to the area near the plant, which makes plant location central to a cement maker's economics.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Freight from Karachi to Lahore, Islamabad or Khyber Pakhtunkhwa can make imported cement dearer than local bags even at zero import duty, so northern makers face limited import competition.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: About 75% of Pakistan's population lives in Punjab and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, the core cement demand region of the north.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst judged northern cement companies to have a better long-term ROIC record than southern ones, which he attributed to regional demand and freight protection.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A plant near large demand centres such as Faisalabad, Lahore and Islamabad saves freight, and the analyst's example says that saving can add about 10% to profit per tonne versus a distant rival.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cement makers can buy coal from international, local or Afghan sources, and a maker that can burn a higher share of the cheapest coal gets a lower cost of production.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: An efficient cement plant uses about 80 to 85 kWh of electricity to make one tonne of cement.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Electricity from a company's own coal power plant was described as cheaper than grid power, so captive generation gives a cost edge to cement makers that own it.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: As a cement plant ages it burns more coal and needs about 90 kWh of power per tonne instead of 80, which the analyst estimated can cut profit per tonne by 15 to 20%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Limestone royalty is set by province and is higher in Punjab than in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, so a plant located in KP carries a lower cost base.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Makers are shifting part of their fuel from local coal to biomass and pet coke, which the analyst says cost less than local coal, lowering production cost for efficient firms.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Within one market, cement bag prices are nearly identical across makers, so differences in profit come mainly from differences in cost of production.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A maker with several lines can shut its least efficient old line and run the newest at full load, while a single-line maker must halt production for spells when demand is weak.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Efficient cement makers keep a materially higher operating margin than less efficient peers in the same region, because cost differences compound on the same selling price.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: One valuation method multiplies a cement company's capacity by a per-tonne value tied to the cost of building a new plant, then adds net cash or subtracts net debt.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst observed that efficient cement stocks tended to trade near replacement cost when the broad market was at moderate levels in those years.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A cement company still repaying debt deserves a lower P/E than a debt-free peer, because repayment delays the cash that reaches shareholders.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Best Cement Company of Pakistan in 2025 !!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Falling policy interest rates lift cement demand because cheaper borrowing supports housing and construction, and the analyst says cement sales respond to the rate fall.
